basic_details.short_information: The Central Institute of Petrochemicals Engineering & Technology (केंद्रीय पेट्रोरसायन अभियांत्रिकी एवं प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान (सिपेट)), CIPET Head Office, Chennai, will engage 3 Consultant (F & A) staff on a contract basis for a fixed period. One position pays a consolidated monthly remuneration of up to ₹70,000, which is negotiable for deserving candidates. The other two positions are for Qualified / Semi Qualified CA / CMA candidates and pay ₹35,000 to ₹70,000. Applications are online only, through a link that opens on 27 October 2026 and closes on 16 November 2026.
